name: AetherBuilder
changelog: Fix: Changelog in Update Hub now scrolls to top automatically so newest fixes show first
Fix: Changelog card height increased (240px) to show more items at once
Fix: Add Section modal grid layout broken on shared hosting - critical styles now inline in JS
Fix: Filter pill active state applied via inline style (works on hosts with cached CSS)
New: Real-time search & filter box in Add New Section modal
New: Quick-filter pills - All / Add-ons / Core Widgets tabs
New: Enter key selects first match; Escape clears or closes modal
New: Mobile-friendly admin studio with slide-over drawer sidebar
New: Built-in Chatbot Assistant quick-toggle in Add-ons panel
New: Custom Live Chat Add-on (Tawk.to, Crisp, WhatsApp float, custom embed)
New: Contact & Hire Me Add-on (EmailJS, Viber, WhatsApp, Phone)
New: Smart non-destructive addon merger on updates
UX: Create Add-On and Install buttons sticky at top of Add-ons panel
UX: Inspector tabs bar sticky when scrolling controls
UX: Repeater filter bar sticks below sticky inspector tabs
UX: Removed redundant floating Publish button
Fix: EmailJS fields moved to Advanced tab only in Contact addon
Fix: Viber deep-link corrected to viber://chat?number= protocol
